scoreArea.title: Corporate Downsizing
scoreArea.rulesText: When you score Corporate Downsizing, show to Runner any number of agenda cards stored in HQ. Gain bits equal to twice the combined agenda points of these cards; then shuffle them into R&D.

scoreArea.title: Project Venice
scoreArea.rulesText: For every three advancement counters over Project Venice 's difficulty that are on Project Venice when you score it, gain an action during each of your turns.

discardCards.title: Core Command: Jettison Ice
discardCards.rulesText: Play only if you made a successful run on HQ this turn. Pay the rez cost of a piece of rezzed ice to trash it.

discardCards.title: Mantis, Fixer-at-Large
discardCards.rulesText: Search your stack for a card, and bring it into your hand. Reshuffle your stack afterwards.

discardCards.title: Forged Activation Orders
discardCards.rulesText: Choose a piece of ice. The Corp either rezzes that piece of ice or trashes it.

discardCards.title: Inside Job
discardCards.rulesText: Make a run. You automatically pass the first piece of ice you encounter during that run.
